step.cmd: Determine if one of the following conditions is met:

ul.li: There are 2 telephone messages that were left at different times of day and at least 24 hours apart for the client to call back.

An email was sent asking the client to call back.
If no condition is met, go to step 2.
If any condition is met, go to step 7.

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the N-10-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Notice to Report for an Interview - in person / by telephone (2707): Select Contact us as soon as possible .
Text - Agent’s Name (1614 ).
Text - Date of interview (3984): Type “As soon as possible before [today’s date +10 business days].”
Text - Time of Interview (1608): Type “Anytime between [hours and days you can be reached, in the client’s time zone].”
Text - Agent phone number (1656) .
Important Message / Must leave phone number (2708): Select Must leave phone number .

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC as follows:

ul.li: Details: Type “Cannot reach the client by telephone. N-10-00-00 letter sent. Moved to Pending until [today’s date + 10 business days].”

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Bring forward date: Enter the date the letter is sent + 10 business days.

step.cmd: If the client calls you within 10 business days of the letter being sent, go to step 8.
If the client does not call you within 10 business days of the letter being sent, go to step 7.
In NWS, add details to the draft SROC as follows:

ul.li: Details: Type “No return call from the client.”
Return to the previous task for next steps, including documenting the file.
If the client’s identity cannot be validated, go to step 9.
If the client’s identity can be validated, go to step 10.

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Main Issue: Select the appropriate issue or Other (if the issue is not in the menu).
Details: Type “Unable to validate client’s identity.”

step.cmd: Explain the reason for the call and conduct fact-finding.
Return to the previous task for next steps, including documenting the file.
